report.summary: A botnet attack was detected on Institution_B's network, originating from IP address 192.168.10.15. The attack has a high confidence level of 0.98.
report.impact: A compromised host that contacts a command-and-control server and may take part in attacks, spam or data theft. The host is under external control and should be treated as compromised.
response_steps: Isolate the infected host from the network
Block the command-and-control address at the firewall and DNS
Reimage the host and reset its credentials

technique_details.name: Application Layer Protocol
technique_details.description: Adversaries may communicate using OSI application layer protocols to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic.
technique_details.mitigations: Filter Network Traffic (M1037), Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031)

technique_details.name: Web Protocols
technique_details.description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with web traffic to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic.
technique_details.mitigations: Filter Network Traffic (M1037), Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031)

technique_details.name: Dynamic Resolution
technique_details.description: Adversaries may dynamically establish connections to command and control infrastructure to evade common detections and remediations.
technique_details.mitigations: Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031), Restrict Web-Based Content (M1021)
